long_biography.plain_text:
Hussein Nuaman Soufraki built his business identity around HNS Group, which he launched in 1961 as a privately held international contracting and property-development company. Its activities grew across residential construction, commercial property, hospitality, leisure, property management and financial services across several international markets. Soufraki was the founder, owner and chairman, roles distinct from those of later executives who share the family name.

HNS established an Egyptian real-estate arm in 2005 and assembled residential properties in several Cairo districts. Its flagship development was Sun City, a mixed-use mall, hotel, entertainment and retail complex near Cairo International Airport. That development illustrates the contracting-to-property route through which Soufraki's wealth was created. The mall, residential portfolio, subsidiaries and other group holdings belong to HNS entities rather than directly to him. The current composition of his holdings and operational role is unresolved. Real estate created the fortune identified with Soufraki, while his current primary industry is unknown.
